323K likes, 1,303 comments - vogueindia on October 28, 2026: "“I would love for there to be a few more poetic, wistful adjectives alongside ‘hard-working’,” Katrina Kaif (@katrinakaif) tells Vogue India. Having watched Sridevi, Rekha and Madhuri Dixit make poetry out of movement when she first entered the industry, she believes dancing should bring the performer genuine joy, however much work goes into it. And if the average party playlist is anything to go by, the audience has been having a pretty good time too.

Read the full cover story at the link in bio.

332K likes, 2,156 comments - vogueindia on October 27, 2026: "Who decided that life after having a baby should be measured by how quickly you can return to life before it? For Katrina Kaif (@katrinakaif), becoming a mother was the culmination of what she describes as a four-year journey with Vicky Kaushal. She’s finally where she wanted to be, and the expectation that she should somehow go backwards seems rather absurd.

Read the full cover story at the link in bio.

310K likes, 1,311 comments - vogueindia on October 28, 2026: "There was a time when Katrina Kaif (@katrinakaif) would call out co-stars for downplaying her achievements mid-interview. These days, she's reconsidering how much attention she gives to public opinion. “We live in a world that wants to blow us around in the ever-changing winds of opinions,” she says. “I just want to focus on this lovely part of my life and where I’m headed.”

Read the full cover story at the link in bio.

345K likes, 1,727 comments - vogueindia on October 28, 2026: "Katrina Kaif (@katrinakaif) has spent the better part of two decades raising a generation of baddies. She’s now enjoying a life that doesn’t need to revolve around the screen. Returning to the cover of Vogue India after eight years, the actor-entrepreneur talks about making peace with things she can’t control and why the public’s opinions about her body aren’t her problem to solve.

Read the full cover story at the link in bio.

posts.meta_description:
82K likes, 492 comments - kaybykatrina on October 9, 2026: "Such a special moment for all of us at Kay Beauty to see a brand born in India find its place at an iconic British beauty destination like @spacenk What started as a passion to create a brand that speaks the beauty language of the South Asian community has become a journey that continues to surprise and inspire us❤️🙏🏻

It makes me so happy to see South Asian brands and voices finding their place on the global beauty stage🙏🏻

Thank you to everyone who came out to celebrate with us, braved the London rain and showed us so much love. Your support makes this journey even more special🫶🏻🫶🏻

Here’s to celebrating beauty in all its forms, speaking your own beauty language, and always remembering #ItsKayToBeYou 🫶🏻🇬🇧

📸: @amanfilmographer 

#KayBeauty #KayBeautyUK #Nykaa".
